profile.headline: Frontend Developer using HTML, CSS, and Javascript to build better ways for people to experience technology.
profile.summary:
I have a passion for frontend code that makes content engaging and accessible. I appreciate organized CSS, semantic HTML and efficient JavaScript. I will champion web accessibility and strong design systems. I enjoy collaboration, learning new skills and solving unexpected puzzles. I've excelled in a remote environment for more than 10 years.

Experienced with: HTML, CSS, web accessibility (WCAG) AA and AAA, JavaScript, Vue, React, HubSpot, WordPress, Drupal, Figma, Zurb Foundation, Bootstrap, on-page search engine optimization, version control (Git, Github, GitLab), Adobe Creative Suite

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: E-commerce frontend web developer coding on the BigCommerce platform.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Translate design mockups and wireframes from Figma into responsive and interactive web components and applications using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React and Handlebars

• Worked with backend developers to ensure consistency of design and functionality from functional mockups to CMS templates for Sitecore.

• Integrate APIs for healthcare sites to enhance search and provider details

• Collaborated using Jira and Microsoft Teams in an agile environment to translate requirements into well-engineered solutions ready for production

• Adhered to existing design systems to build reusable, modular components and suggest updates for future scalability

• Worked with a variety of frameworks including Foundation, Bootstrap and custom-built themes

• Evaluated websites and pages for web accessibility according to WCAG AA and AAA

• Ensured that page templates and components allow content authors to optimize information for search engines

• Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade legacy code

positions.title: Senior Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with content creators to develop engaging web products using Javascript, CSS and HTML.

• Built interactive page elements and polished blog posts for WordPress, HubSpot and Drupal. 

• Worked with design team to transform Invision mockups into pixel-perfect themes and templates for WordPress and HubSpot. 

• Experience using plugins like Advanced Custom Fields and Gravity Forms to develop unique projects that stayed on budget. 

• Delivered documentation to guide editors on how to use their CMS effectively.

positions.title: Content Coordinator
positions.description:
• Research online channels and trending news stories to brainstorm new content ideas. 

• Create original web content on a variety of subjects. Written for humans, optimized for search engines.

• Format blog content for success with quality photos, strong hierarchy for on-page SEO and hand-crafted meta-information. 

• Source images and customize for different uses including blog posts and social media sites.  

• Front-end development with a focus on building authoritative websites using WordPress, PHP, CSS3 and HTML5.

positions.title: Freelance Designer, Developer
positions.description:
Taken a broad range of design and development projects from conception to completion. Projects included print design, web design and development, and social media marketing.

On the Web 
• Built and configured WordPress themes to create websites for SMB clients. 
• Plan site architecture for search engine optimization. 
• Vet and configure plugins to create custom page elements. 
• Training and documentation.

In Print
• Branding: identity designs, logos and business card.
• Marketing collateral: postcards, flyers, posters and advertisements.
• Layout Designs: newsletters (4-16 pages), annual reports, advertising directories/catalogs (80-100 pgs).

positions.title: Managing Editor, WordPress Developer / Designer
positions.description:
Design, development and maintenance for two websites with 100K-800K monthly traffic: AppCraver.com and TutorialBlog.org.

• Web design and maintenance to keep WordPress themes and plugins compliant with current web standards. 

• Customized a plugin to connect to the iTunes API and showcase app rankings, prices and details with links for affiliate marketing. 

• Design web-optimized graphics for media promotions, marketing presentations, online advertising, and email marketing.

• Hire freelance writers and manage editorial content for both websites and social media properties. 

• Write and edit app reviews, design tutorials and articles. 

• Ensure all blog posts and web pages were optimized for search engine visibility.

positions.title: Wordpress Expert, Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Used Wordpress to build, manage and maintain a variety of websites in the emerging custom TLD space. 

• Design business cards and marketing collateral for each prospective TLDs.

• Handled design and layout for long reports and business proposals using Microsoft Word.

• Created branded spreadsheets in Microsoft Excel.

positions.description:
Bard's Art has transitioned into TalkStory Media.

• Graphic design services for SMB and local politics.

• Created marketing collateral, flyers, postcards, brochures and advertisements.

• Designed and built HTML websites for SMB.

positions.title: Design Editor
positions.description:
• Page layout, pre-press production and advertising design for a weekly newspaper. 

• Page layout and advertising design for an annual business directory, approximately 80 pages with spot color interior and 4-color cover.

• Spearheaded the project to build the company's original HTML website and later migrated the site to WordPress. 

• Prepare photos for print publication, digital restoration, and media management.

• Writing articles and copy-editing press releases for publication.
